British.name: British English
British.key_features: Non-rhotic, broad TRAP-BATH split (/ɑː/), LOT-CLOTH distinction, coda T-glottaling.

American.name: American English
American.key_features: Fully rhotic post-vocalic /r/, voiced alveolar tapping [ɾ] in 'water', LOT-PALM merger.

Australian.name: Australian English
Australian.key_features: Australian vowel shift (diphthongized FLEECE and wide FACE), backed PRICE, non-rhotic.

Pakistani.name: Pakistani English
Pakistani.key_features: Retroflex plosives [ʈ, ɖ], dental stops for fricatives [t̪, d̪], syllable-timed cadence, prosthetic s-clusters.

Indian.name: Indian English
Indian.key_features: Retroflex consonants, monophthongal /eː/ and /oː/, syllable-timed isochronous rhythm, [ʋ] approximation.

Irish.name: Irish English
Irish.key_features: Rhotic with alveolar tap [ɾ], T-slitting [t̞], clear /l/ in all environments, lilting musical intonation.

Scottish.name: Scottish English
Scottish.key_features: Tapped/trilled /r/ [ɾ], voiceless velar fricative /x/ in 'loch', Aitken's Vowel Length Rule, POOL-PULL merger.
